memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: The Lord said to Moses, "Accept these from them, that they may be used in the work at the tent of meeting. Give them to the Levites as each man's work requires." So Moses took the carts and oxen and gave them to the Levites. He gave two carts and four oxen to the Gershonites, as their work required, and he gave four carts and eight oxen to the Merarites, as their work required. But Moses did not give any to the Kohathites, because they were to carry on their shoulders the holy things, for which they were responsible. - Num 7:4-9 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The gifts were distributed wisely — but not equally. The Merarites, who carried the heavy frames and posts, received more carts and oxen. The Gershonites, with lighter loads of curtains, received fewer. And the Kohathites received none at all, because they carried the holy things on their shoulders.

At first this might seem unfair. But look closer: each was given exactly what their work required. God's provision was matched to each one's actual need. More was given where more was needed; less where less was needed; and the Kohathites' special task called for no carts at all.

This is a beautiful picture of how God provides. He does not give everyone the same thing, because we do not all carry the same load. He gives each of us what our particular calling requires. Comparing our provision to someone else's misses the point — God is meeting our specific need, not running a system of identical portions.

There is honour, too, in the Kohathites carrying the holy things on their shoulders. Their task was so sacred that it called for personal, careful bearing, not a cart. What looked like "receiving less" was actually a mark of a special trust.

Trust God to give you what your calling truly requires. He knows your load, and He provides accordingly. "My God will meet all your needs according to the riches of his glory in Christ Jesus" (Phil 4:19).

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you compare God's provision for you with others'?
- Can you trust that God gives you what your calling truly requires?
- Where do you need to rely on God's provision today?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You that You provide for each of us according to our need. Help me to trust Your wise provision instead of comparing with others. Amen.
